Title: New APIs for Azure Storage Resource Provider

Body.Content:
With general availability, Azure Storage Resource Provider (SRP) now offers two new APIs:
  • Get Operations: Displays the list of available SRP operations
  • Get Usage: Displays the number of accounts created by a subscription and the maximum number of accounts that can be created (100)
For more information, see Azure Storage Resource Provider REST API Reference.
